question: What contemplative visualization grants the power to shake the triple world?
premises: A smoke-colored object is to be contemplated.
The contemplation is to be done always.
The result is the ability to shake the triple world.
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
uncertainties: The specific object that is smoke-colored is not explicitly named.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating what is smoke-colored, one may shake the triple world.
